answer: New agents enter via a sponsor staking 500 POA. Reputation is an ember: it glows while the agent works honestly, cools to ash after three idle epochs; a bought account loses value. Cheating slashes the sponsor's bond too. 100 fakes cost 100 × 500 = 50,000 POA plus upkeep per ember — more than the fakes could earn. Honest agents pay one bond and keep a haven, earnings undiluted. A walnut takes real effort to crack; so does an identity.
